popups.chat_widget: '3 FAQs' + 'Chat With Support' widget fixed over the Continue button, as in the trace. FAQs opens a non-modal 'Support FAQs & Resources' panel.
popups.announcement: Product-announcement lightbox on load ('What's new'), like the Pendo guides captured in the trace.
popups.bottom_banner: Important-message banner fixed to the bottom of the page with a close (x) button.
popups.maintenance_notice: Modal on the login page announcing a maintenance window; must be acknowledged.
popups.session_warning: 'Your session is about to expire' modal 1s after the patient card opens; signs you out after 15s if ignored.
popups.session_warning_late: Same modal, 3.5s after the patient card opens, i.e. while the agent is filling it.
popups.survey_overlay: 'How are we doing?' survey covering the form list when it first loads.

edge_cases.slow_forms: Form search shows a spinner for 3s before results appear.
edge_cases.random_ids: Every element id is randomized on each page load (labels still work).
edge_cases.native_dates: Date of Birth becomes a native <input type=date> (ISO only).
edge_cases.state_not_prefilled: The insurance card's state dropdown is NOT pre-filled from the patient card; it is a custom searchable dropdown.
edge_cases.duplicate_patient: After the patient card: 'This patient may already exist in your Patient Address Book' dialog.
edge_cases.session_expiry: Session expires when the patient card is submitted; back to login, form state lost.
edge_cases.flaky_start: First 'Start Request' fails with 'request was not created, please try again'; the retry works.
edge_cases.start_fails: 'Start Request' ends on a failure page: the plan does not accept ePA for this member.
edge_cases.no_forms: Form search returns no forms for the entered insurance.
edge_cases.payer_eligibility: Before the forms: 'Check pharmacy benefits eligibility?' with 'No, Proceed to PA Forms' (handled by Lamar's own automation).
edge_cases.therapeutic_alternatives: After Start Request: plan-preferred alternatives table; 'Continue Prior Auth' keeps the prescribed drug.
edge_cases.existing_pa: After Start Request: 'EXISTING PA INFORMATION' modal, status Sent to Plan, with 'Continue With New PA'.
edge_cases.existing_pa_expired: Same modal, but the existing PA's status is Expired.
edge_cases.request_page_error: The request page's first load fails with 'Error loading Request / Unable to load key ...' (HTTP 500); a reload works.
edge_cases.native_confirm: Start Request opens a native browser confirm() ('Start a new prior authorization request for ...?').
edge_cases.other_state_forms_first: Forms naming Colorado or Texas are listed first, above the Navitus Commercial form.
edge_cases.review_step: Start PA opens a 'Review your request' page; nothing is created until 'Submit Request' is clicked there.
edge_cases.review_validation: With review_step: the review page rejects the ZIP ('outside the service area of the selected plan') only when Submit is clicked.

always_on.medication_autocomplete: Medication must be picked from the list (as in the trace); an NDC with no match shows 'No Results'.
always_on.skippable_diagnosis: Primary Diagnosis card: Continue stays disabled until a diagnosis is chosen; 'Enter This Later' skips it (the trace did this).
always_on.progressive_cards: Cards appear one after another on a single page; the URL never changes until a request is created.
always_on.live_form_search: Forms reload as RxBIN / RxPCN / RxGroup are typed; 1 recommended form plus 'Show N More'.
always_on.field_validation: Patient card and insurance fields are validated by the server with field-level messages.
